claims.text: Contact non-polarized dermoscopy showed a non-specific homogeneous pattern, and polarized dermoscopy showed polymorphic central vessels with whitish areas on an erythematous structureless background. Histopathology showed a nodular dermal proliferation of epithelioid cells in dense collagenous stroma, with mild to moderate atypia and occasional mitotic figures, without higher-grade cytonuclear atypia or perineural invasion. Immunohistochemistry was positive for CD10, MiTF, NSE, vimentin and SMA and negative for fifteen other markers; a diagnosis of cellular neurothekeoma was made based on the immunophenotypic profile and morphological features.
